text: Code

Purpose
Curated analyses and tools from STRATEGIOS made accessible to practitioners and the public. Bilingual Swedish/English.

Structure
website/
├── _quarto.yml          # Site config
├── index.qmd            # Landing page (bilingual)
├── about.qmd            # About STRATEGIOS
├── analyses/            # Published analyses from subprojects
│   └── blai/            # Language complexity analysis
├── tools/               # Practitioner tools
│   └── strategitavlan.qmd
└── _site/               # Generated output (gitignored)

Workflow

Write/update .qmd files
quarto preview for local development
quarto render to build
git push to GitHub
Pull from cPanel at Oderland

Design
Uses STRATEGIOS brand identity:

Inter typeface
Black/white high contrast
Generous whitespace
Clean tables and figures

See custom.scss for theme customization.

Adding analyses

Create folder in analyses/ (e.g., analyses/dna-i/)
Add index.qmd with content
Update navbar menu in _quarto.yml
Render and push

Content sources
Analyses are adapted from STRATEGIOS subprojects:

BLAI → ../../CORPUS/BLAI/
Strategitavlan → ../../STRATEGITAVLAN/

Keep website content self-contained (copy, don’t symlink).

Git Remote

title: STRATEGIOS
text:
About
STRATEGIOS examines how Swedish public organizations develop strategy. We analyze strategic documents from municipalities, regions, and state agencies using NLP-based text analysis combined with surveys and interviews.
The research program is based at the University of Gothenburg, led by Kristian Norling.

title: About / Om
text:
EnglishSvenska



The Research Program
STRATEGIOS is a research program at the University of Gothenburg examining strategic management in Swedish public sector. The program started in 2020 and now comprises 35+ integrated subprojects.


Research Questions

How do Swedish public organizations formulate their strategies?
What role do strategists play in public sector?
How are digital strategies and sustainability strategies connected?
Is municipal strategic communication becoming more similar over time?



Methods
The program combines:

Computational text analysis – Topic modeling, NER, semantic embeddings
Quantitative analysis – Linguistic complexity metrics, time series
Qualitative research – In-depth interviews, case studies
Mixed methods – Q-methodology, gap analysis



Researcher
Kristian Norling PhD Candidate, Department of Applied IT University of Gothenburg
GU Staff Page


Publications
Coming soon: List of publications from the research program.


Funding
The research program is funded by the University of Gothenburg.




Forskningsprogrammet
STRATEGIOS är ett forskningsprogram vid Göteborgs universitet som undersöker strategisk styrning i svensk offentlig sektor. Programmet startade 2020 och omfattar idag 35+ integrerade delprojekt.


Forskningsfrågor

Hur formulerar svenska myndigheter sina strategier?
Vilken roll spelar strateger i offentlig sektor?
Hur hänger digitala strategier och hållbarhetsstrategier ihop?
Blir kommunernas strategiska kommunikation mer likartad över tid?



Metod
Programmet kombinerar:

Computational text analysis – Topic modeling, NER, semantiska embeddings
Kvantitativ analys – Lingvistiska komplexitetsmått, tidsserieanalys
Kvalitativ forskning – Djupintervjuer, fallstudier
Mixed methods – Q-metodologi, gap-analys

title: Strategitavlan
text:
Strategitavlan is a practical framework with 8 elements for structuring strategy work. It has been developed through action design research together with Swedish public sector strategists.

title: BLAI – Language Complexity · Språkkomplexitet
text:
BLAI (Bureaucratic Language Analysis Index) is a framework for measuring complexity in Swedish government documents. The index combines 9 linguistic metrics into a normalized score (0–1).


BLAI (Bureaucratic Language Analysis Index) är ett ramverk för att mäta komplexiteten i svenska myndighetstexter. Indexet kombinerar 9 lingvistiska metriker till ett normaliserat mått (0–1).
